newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber in mild buying, seen bearish.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber in mild buying, seen bearish.

text.p: Mild shortcovering was seen in the Singapore rubber market on Friday, dealers said.
"There was some shortcovering in the market. I think Michelin will try to finish their monthly buying programme. I think they wanted to buy some nearby supplies of RSS3 today," a dealer said.
A trading source said Michelin did some routine business, mostly for RSS3 rubber and small consignments of TSR20 rubber.

"They buy rubber continuously. Most of their purchases are for nearby months and they do rarely do forward purchases. They're doing a lot of routine business at the moment," he said. Bridgestone was said to have bought some TSR20 rubber midweek, but has not been seen in the market.
"Michelin is about the only one regularly in the market the past few days although others were likewise engaged in small-scale buying," a dealer said.
Traders said the market was largely quiet except for the speculative shortcovering seen in RSS3 and TSR20 rubber.
